name: beam
title: Beam
description: A travelling light around an element's edge, for the one thing on a screen that needs the eye.
docs: Wrap the element that has turned urgent -- a goal about to break its streak, a check-in whose window is closing. Built for a Card but wraps anything with a border radius; the layers inherit border-radius from the wrapper, so pass the child's radius when it is not rounded-xl. The light is decoration in pseudo-elements, invisible to assistive tech, and tone is colour alone, so what makes the element urgent must be in its text too. Reduced motion holds the light still rather than removing it. Use one at a time: a second one on screen costs both of them their effect.
